body.title: Standalone brainstorm context type
body.summary: Create src/workflow/runners/brainstorm/standalone.ts exporting StandaloneBrainstormContext { readonly focus: string }, a peer of design-story's StandaloneStoryContext (standalone.ts:23), for invoking brainstorm outside an Epic with just a rough focus string.
acceptanceChecks: standalone.ts exports StandaloneBrainstormContext with exactly one required field, focus: string, mirroring the shape of design-story's StandaloneStoryContext
compiles cleanly under strict TS / exactOptionalPropertyTypes with no optional-field handling needed since focus is required

tests.name: StandaloneBrainstormContext accepts a bare focus string (peer of StandaloneStoryContext)
